design_system_identity.aesthetic_archetype: High-Density Industrial SCADA with Tactical Metallic Depth & Precision Neon Accents
design_system_identity.core_philosophy: Evolutionary enhancement (no rewrite). Grounding dark glassmorphism into a tactile, heavy-gauge steel & graphite SCADA control console. Deep surface layering, metallic edge highlights, bevels, inset telemetry wells, and hyper-legible monospaced data density paired with vibrant neon status indicators.

font_families.body_ui: IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

hierarchy_rules.h1_hero_dashboard_title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-sans uppercase font-bold tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-100 drop-shadow-sm
hierarchy_rules.h2_section_header: text-xs font-sans font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-slate-300
hierarchy_rules.h3_card_title: text-[11px] font-sans font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-400 group-hover:text-slate-200 transition-colors
hierarchy_rules.telemetry_primary_metric: font-mono text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight leading-none

surface_layers.console_frame: Deep slate background with dark metallic radial gradient mesh (#04060c to #080c16)
surface_layers.scada_card_glass: background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(20, 30, 51, 0.85) 0%, rgba(10, 16, 28, 0.90) 100%), 1px solid rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.15), backdrop-blur(24px)
surface_layers.recessed_input_well: background: rgba(4, 6, 12, 0.80), border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10), shadow: inset 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.7)

border_and_panel_treatments.chamfer_details: 4px subtle corner radius with top 2px metallic accent hairline stroke

cards_and_panels.glass_card_container: glass card-lift group relative overflow-hidden h-full flex flex-col rounded-md border border-slate-700/40 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#141e33]/90 to-[#0a101c]/95 shadow-[0_18px_40px_-22px_rgba(0,0,0,0.85)]
cards_and_panels.card_header: relative border-b border-slate-700/30 bg-gradient-to-b from-white/[0.04] to-transparent px-4 py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-3

kpi_strip_card.container: relative overflow-hidden rounded-md border border-slate-700/40 bg-slate-900/80 p-3.5 backdrop-blur-md transition-all duration-200 hover:border-slate-500/50 shadow-md
kpi_strip_card.label: font-sans text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-400
kpi_strip_card.value_mono: font-mono text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-100 mt-1

component_recipes.section_header: flex items-center gap-3 pt-2 pb-1 border-b border-slate-800/60 mb-3

buttons.primary: btn-neo inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 font-mono text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-100 bg-gradient-to-b from-slate-700/60 to-slate-800/80 border border-slate-500/40 rounded shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.2),0_2px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] hover:from-slate-600/70 hover:to-slate-700/90 active:translate-y-[1px] transition-all
buttons.secondary: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300 bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-700/60 rounded hover:bg-slate-700/60 hover:text-white transition-all
buttons.ghost: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 font-mono text-xs text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-800/40 rounded transition-all
buttons.danger: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-red-200 bg-red-950/60 border border-red-500/40 rounded shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(239,68,68,0.2)] hover:bg-red-900/80 hover:border-red-400 transition-all

inputs_and_controls.text_and_number_input: glass-input w-full px-3 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs text-slate-100 bg-slate-950/80 border border-slate-700/60 rounded focus:border-cyan-500/70 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-cyan-500/30 transition-all placeholder:text-slate-600
inputs_and_controls.slider_track: h-2 w-full rounded bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 shadow-inner
inputs_and_controls.slider_thumb: h-4 w-4 rounded-full bg-cyan-400 border border-white shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(6,182,212,0.8)] cursor-pointer

pills_and_badges.base_badge: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-mono text-[9px] uppercase tracking-[0.16em] font-semibold border backdrop-blur-sm

nav_tabs.container: flex items-center gap-1 p-1 bg-slate-950/80 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-md backdrop-blur-md
nav_tabs.active_tab: font-mono text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white bg-gradient-to-b from-slate-700/80 to-slate-800/90 border border-slate-600/60 rounded px-3.5 py-1.5 shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.15),0_2px_4px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]
nav_tabs.inactive_tab: font-mono text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-900/60 rounded px-3.5 py-1.5 transition-all

system_status_light.ok: w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 shadow-[0_0_10px_#10b981,0_0_20px_#10b981aa] border border-emerald-200/50 dot-pulse
system_status_light.warning: w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-amber-400 shadow-[0_0_10px_#f59e0b,0_0_20px_#f59e0baa] border border-amber-200/50 dot-pulse
system_status_light.alarm: w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-red-500 shadow-[0_0_12px_#ef4444,0_0_24px_#ef4444aa] border border-red-200/50 animate-ping

tables.table_wrapper: w-full overflow-hidden rounded-md border border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/60
tables.header_cell: px-3 py-2 text-left font-mono text-[10px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider text-slate-400 bg-slate-900/80 border-b border-slate-800

motion_and_microinteractions.energy_flow_particle_lines: SVG stroke-dasharray with keyframe 'flow-particles' moving continuously; speed varies by wattage
motion_and_microinteractions.led_status_pulses: dot-pulse animation (0% to 100% opacity with current-color glow shadow)
motion_and_microinteractions.card_hover_elevation: card-lift effect (-4px translateY with subtle silver edge border highlight)
motion_and_microinteractions.reduced_motion: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) disables flow-particles and pulse keyframes

accessibility_and_testing.contrast_compliance: Normal text meets 4.5:1 minimum against dark slate wells; telemetry numbers in JetBrains Mono use bright silver (#F8FAFC) or neon accents with text-shadow.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, sliders, inputs, nav tabs, status badges) and primary stat cards MUST include explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-tab-dashboard', data-testid='kpi-pv-power').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Do NOT rewrite or remove existing components or page routes.

2. Update /app/frontend/src/index.css to enhance CSS variable declarations (--background, --card, --border) and augment .glass, .glass-strong, .glass-inset, .btn-neo with tactile silver/slate border highlights and SCADA shadows.
3. Update /app/frontend/tailwind.config.js to include SCADA slate/steel color definitions (e.g. slate-metal, graphite-muted, titanium-white, obsidian-border).
4. Refine /app/frontend/src/components/solar-ui.jsx styling for GlassCard, Badge, MetricBig, and SectionHeader to apply metallic chamfers, top accent hairlines, and SCADA control room density.
5. Ensure all key controls and status elements retain or gain kebab-case data-testid attributes for automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never create standard centered white layouts or generic blue SaaS cards.
Maintain the dark SCADA control-room aesthetic with layered metallic surfaces, monospaced telemetry data, crisp 1px borders, and vivid neon status indicators.
Every button, input, slider, tab, and card must include explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.
Ensure hover and active states provide high visual feedback with subtle metallic edge highlights and glows.
